answer: The ledger escrows every reward earned by an account under 60 epochs old, vesting it over 5 epochs per newcomer in the network-wide cohort. With 40 young accounts, pay for patching a Jetty server vests over 200 epochs. A farm's 41st fake stretches all its escrows to 205. The count is on-chain, so parallel joins only enlarge it, and each extra key lengthens every earlier lock. A fraud proof burns whatever is unvested, shown in umber on the Ember dashboard.
